name: Ta-Ta
description: Supermarket chain in Uruguay with an online store on the VTEX platform, selling groceries, beverages, household and personal care, and small appliances. Home delivery is limited to 15 listed localities; customers elsewhere can order but must choose a branch pickup. Free home delivery above a stated threshold.
description_es: Cadena de supermercados de Uruguay con tienda online sobre la plataforma VTEX, que vende comestibles, bebidas, limpieza, cuidado personal y pequeños electrodomésticos. La entrega a domicilio se limita a 15 localidades; desde otras zonas se puede comprar, pero se retira en sucursal. Envío gratis por encima de un monto indicado.

ships_to.notes: Home delivery limited to 15 listed localities; orders from elsewhere require branch pickup.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Free pickup at enabled branches; hours vary by city.

sources.supports: localities with home delivery, branch pickup, free-shipping threshold
